tagline: Bookmark any Odoo record and open it instantly from a personal sidebar
problem: Odoo has no universal bookmark system. Users juggle browser tabs, stars, and copy-paste links to reopen the same records every day.
solution: Universal Bookmark adds one-click stars on form, list, and Kanban views, a searchable personal sidebar with drag-and-drop ordering, folders, pins, favorites, recent history, and Ctrl+B navigation.
benefits: Bookmark any record on any model with one click
List and Kanban star columns for fast marking
Personal sidebar with search, pins, favorites, and recent

features.title: Bookmark anywhere
features.text: Star records from form headers, list rows, Kanban cards, or Ctrl+B.

features.title: Personal sidebar
features.text: Search and reopen bookmarks from the systray panel without leaving your screen.

features.title: Pins, favorites, recent
features.text: Keep urgent records on top and revisit recent work quickly.

features.title: Drag-and-drop ordering
features.text: Reorder pinned, folder, and unfiled bookmarks in the sidebar.

features.title: Folders and colors
features.text: Group customers, sales, invoices, and projects with color labels.

features.title: List and menu bookmarks
features.text: Save filtered list views, menus, and reports for one-click reopen.

workflow: Click the star or press Ctrl+B
seo_keywords: Odoo 20 universal bookmark, record bookmarks, productivity sidebar, list view star, kanban bookmark, ARMORA
